label: February 28
event: 1827 — The Baltimore and Ohio Railroad is chartered, the first U.S. railroad chartered for commercial passenger and freight service. A steadfast citizen reading this remembers that durable national infrastructure was built by men who bound themselves to long-term work no one was forcing on them — the freely chosen ceiling that holds when the floor wobbles.

label: February 28
event: 1844 — The USS Princeton's "Peacemaker" gun explodes during a Potomac River demonstration, killing Secretary of State Abel Upshur, Secretary of the Navy Thomas Gilmer, and six others; President Tyler is below deck and survives. A reminder that even the strongest engines of state can fail catastrophically when men trust the metal more than the LORD — and that a steadfast citizen treats every public office, every public moment, as held in lent hands.
